errors.text_span: 两个饼图之间通过一条斜线连接
errors.evidence: The figure shows two lines, not one, connecting the yellow slice of the left chart to the entire right chart. This indicates that the right chart is a breakdown of the yellow slice, a structural relationship that the description misrepresents.

The description fails to mention the crucial relationship shown by the connecting lines: that the right pie chart is a detailed breakdown of the category represented by the yellow slice ('单音形容词+单音名词') in the left pie chart.

errors.text_span: 但图例与左侧饼图的切片颜色匹配，与右侧饼图的切片颜色不完全对应
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The legend (1=Blue, 2=Orange, 3=Green) only partially matches the left chart (which has blue and yellow slices) but perfectly matches the right chart (which has orange and green slices). The description states the opposite.
